```{r introduction, warning=FALSE, results='asis', eval=TRUE}
# Determine format type for proper display of tables
format_type <- ifelse(report_type=="HTML", "html", "latex")

# Locate correct banner file
ma_banner <- paste0(
  "https://dev.florida-seacar.org/images/bgs/ma-", 
  as.character(MA_All[ManagedAreaName==ma, AreaID]), 
  ".jpg")

# BADGES
# Set badge size for display at top of report (all of them together)
badge_size_percentage <- 50
# Create data frame which will be used to construct PDF/HTML versions of tables to display badges
badge_info <- data.table(
  "HabitatShortName" = c("sav", "wc", "coral", "oyster", "cw"),
  "HabitatName" = c("Submerged Aquatic Vegetation", "Water Column", "Coral Reef", "Oyster Reef", "Coastal Wetlands"),
  "image_loc" = c(
    "data/icons/sav_badge.png", "data/icons/wc_badge.png", 
    "data/icons/coral_badge.png", "data/icons/oyster_badge.png", "data/icons/cw_badge.png")
)
# Function to create badge table with PDF or HTML capability
make_badge_table <- function(report_type, caption = TRUE, badge_size_percentage = 50){
  badge_info %>% 
    mutate(
      image_loc = case_when(
        report_type=="HTML" & caption ~ paste0("![", HabitatName, "](", image_loc, "){width=", badge_size_percentage, "%}"),
        report_type=="HTML" & !caption ~ paste0("![](", image_loc, "){width=", badge_size_percentage, "%}"),
        report_type=="PDF" & caption ~ paste0(
          "
          \\begin{minipage}[t]{0.18\\textwidth}
          \\centering
          \\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth]{", image_loc, "}\\\\
          \\vspace{2mm}
          \\small ", HabitatName, 
          "\\end{minipage}"
        ),
        report_type=="PDF" & !caption ~ paste0("\\includegraphics[width=0.18\\textwidth]{", image_loc, "}")
      )
    ) %>% 
    select(HabitatShortName, image_loc) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = HabitatShortName, values_from = image_loc)
}

# Function to center badges
center_badge <- function(text, report_type){
  if(report_type=="HTML"){
    cat(glue('<center>\n\n{text}\n\n</center>'))
  } else if(report_type=="PDF"){
    cat(paste0("\\begin{center}", text, "\\end{center}"))
  }
}

# BEGIN REPORT
cat("\\newpage")
cat("# Introduction")

if(display_banners & length(ma_banner)>0){
  cat("  \n")
  subchunkify(cat("![](", ma_banner,")"))
  cat("  \n")
}

cat("  \n")
cat(glue("<p>SEACAR is a collaborative, stakeholder-driven project which brings together data from inventory and monitoring programs and research studies and provides this data to the public in a standardized and easily accessible format. The following habitats are available within SEACAR: </p>"))

# Display badges in introduction (PDF and HTML)
cat(
  SEACAR::subchunkify(
    knitr::kable(
      make_badge_table(report_type, caption = TRUE, badge_size_percentage), 
      format = format_type, 
      col.names = NULL,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = "c",
      booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>% 
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", 
                  latex_options = "HOLD_position")
  )
)
cat("  \n")

cat(glue("<p>The purpose of this report is to provide an overview of the status and trends within *{ma}*, based on data available through SEACAR.</p>"))
intro_snippet <- ma_intros %>% filter(ManagedAreaName==ma) %>% pull(IntroText)
cat(intro_snippet)
cat("  \n")
```

```{r status_and_trends, results = 'asis', eval = show_status_and_trends_tables}
# Currently only compatible with HTML format
cat("\\newpage")
cat("# Status and Trends")
cat("  \n")
cat("The summary table provides an overview of the status and trends analyses results for the habitats and indicators within this managed area. The indicators selected were identified by stakeholders as meaningful measures to assess the status of our estuarine managed areas.")
cat("  \n")
# Read in final trend statements excel file
trends <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("../../Atlas-Tools/ModelAggregation/output/TrendStatusText_Final.xlsx") %>% 
  filter(Website==1)
# Function to assign icons for each trend type (1, 0, -1, NA)
apply_icons <- function(trend){
  if(trend==2){
    "data/icons/insuff-data.png"
  } else if(trend==3){
    "data/icons/no-analysis-medium-icon.png"
  } else if(trend==1){
    "data/icons/increase-medium-icon.png"
  } else if(trend==-1){
    "data/icons/decrease-medium-icon.png"
  } else if(trend==0){
    "data/icons/no-trend-medium-icon.png"
  }
}
# Apply function
trends <- trends %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(icon = apply_icons(Trend))
# Select relevant status and trends info for each MA
status_and_trends_table <- trends %>% filter(ManagedAreaName==ma) %>%
  select(-c("ManagedAreaName","AreaID","SufficientData", "Trend", "Website", "Region"))
status_and_trends_table$Trend <- ""
status_and_trends_table$Text <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", status_and_trends_table$Text)

if(report_type=="PDF"){
  status_and_trends_table <- status_and_trends_table %>%
    mutate(Text = gsub(
      "<p>|</p>", 
      "", 
      stringr::str_wrap(Text, 60) %>% linebreak(align = "l")
    ))
}

status_and_trends_table <- status_and_trends_table %>%
  rename(`State of the Indicator` = Text)

# Create kable object with trend icons
kable <- status_and_trends_table %>% 
  select(-c(icon)) %>%
  kable(format = format_type, escape = F, booktabs = T, linesep = "\\hline") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position")) %>%
  column_spec(4, image = spec_image(status_and_trends_table$icon, 100, 100))

if(report_type=="PDF"){
  kable <- kable %>%
    column_spec(4, width = "3cm", latex_valign = "m")
  # kable <- kable %>%
  #   column_spec(4, width = "3cm") %>%
  #   row_spec(1:nrow(status_and_trends_table), hline_after = TRUE)
}

cat("  \n")
cat(SEACAR::subchunkify(kable))
cat("  \n")  

```

```{r plottingWQDiscrete, warning=FALSE, fig.height=9, fig.width=10, results="asis", eval=TRUE}
if(in_discrete){
  ma_df <- managed_area_df %>% dplyr::filter(ManagedAreaName == ma)
  p_inc <- unique(ma_df$Parameter)
  d_inc <- unique(ma_df$Depth)
  a_inc <- unique(ma_df$Activity)
  # Determine order of indicator/parameter display
  param_order <- websiteParams[SamplingFrequency=="Discrete" & ParameterShort %in% p_inc, ]
  
  cat("\\newpage")
  cat("  \n")
  cat("# Water Column")
  cat("  \n")
  
  # Add water column badge
  center_badge(
    paste(
      make_badge_table(
        report_type, 
        caption = FALSE, 
        badge_size_percentage = if(knitr::is_html_output()) 20 else badge_size_percentage
      )[["wc"]]),
    report_type
  )
  
  # Paste in descriptive snippet about water column
  if(show_descriptive_snippets){
    cat(knitr::knit_child('snippets/WC_Descriptive_Snippet.Rmd', quiet=TRUE))
    cat("  \n")    
  }
  
  cat("  \n")
  cat("For more information on water column analysis methods, see the [Analysis Methods](#am_wc) section.")
  cat("  \n")
  cat("  \n")
  
  cat("## Water Quality - Discrete  \n")
  cat("  \n")
  show_disc_programs(ma, data)
  cat("  \n")
  
  for(ind_short in unique(param_order$IndicatorShort)){
    indicator <- param_order[IndicatorShort==ind_short, unique(IndicatorName)]
    cat(glue("### {indicator}"))
    cat("  \n")
    # Show indicator level descriptive snippets
    if(show_descriptive_snippets && show_descriptive_indicator_snippets){
      SEACAR::subchunkify(cat(knitr::knit_child(glue('snippets/WC_{ind_short}_Descriptive_Snippet.Rmd'), quiet=TRUE)))
      cat("  \n")
    }
    # Loop through available parameters
    for(param in param_order[IndicatorShort==ind_short, unique(ParameterShort)]){
      # load overall discrete data
      data <- as.data.frame(load_data_table(param, table="data"))
      
      # getting full parameter & unit names
      parameter <- unique(data$ParameterName)
      unit <- unique(data$ParameterUnits)
      
      cat("  \n")
      subtitle <- glue("#### {parameter} - Discrete")
      cat(subtitle, "\n\n")
      
      # Discrete parameter descriptions
      # Exception to include TN calculation logic
      # Loads external .Rmd for ease of formatting
      if(param %in% snippetParams){
        cat("  \n")
        if(param=="TN"){
          cat(knitr::knit_child('snippets/TN_Calculation_Description.Rmd', quiet=TRUE))
          cat("  \n")
          cat("\\newpage")
          cat("  \n")
        }
      }
      
      ## Show Discrete plots ##
      # Plot
      plot_trendlines(param = parameter, ma = ma, ma_abrev = ma_abrev, report_type = report_type)
      # Map
      if(show_sample_location_maps){
        plot_discrete_maps(ma_abrev = ma_abrev, param_short = param, param_label = parameter, map_files = discrete_map_locs)
      }
      # Program Table
      disc_program_tables(ma = ma, data = data)
    }
  }
}

```

```{r analysis methods, results = 'asis'}
# Add coral when new text is available
cat(glue("# Analysis Methods"))

if(in_discrete | in_continuous | in_nekton){
  cat(knitr::knit_child('snippets/WC_AnalysisMethods.Rmd', quiet=TRUE))
  cat("  \n")
```
